hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: Implements a 1:1 ETH↔phiETH custom-curve hook that bypasses the concentrated liquidity AMM entirely. In beforeSwap, it takes the input token from the pool manager, deposits or withdraws via phiEth, and settles the output directly, returning a full BeforeSwapDelta to no-op the normal swap. Direct liquidity addition is blocked; pools must use ETH/phiETH with zero fee.
